(b) Prove that if the ratio test works, the root test will also. Hint: Use a
problem from the previous chapter.
It is easy to construct series for which the ratio test fails, while the root test
works. For example, the root test shows that the series
PRE RCO CR COME
converges, even though the ratios of successive terms do not approach a
limit. Most examples are of this rather artificial nature, but the root test is
nevertheless quite an important theoretical tool.
